sql: UPDATE assets SET is_flight_asset = 1, is_simulator = 1, sim_rate = 50 WHERE id = {asset}
UPDATE students SET training_goal = 'private' WHERE id = {student}
INSERT INTO acs_ratings (name, slug, uploaded_at, status) VALUES ('Private Pilot ACS', 'private-pilot-acs', datetime('now'), 'parsed')
INSERT INTO acs_areas (rating_id, code, title, order_index) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM acs_ratings WHERE slug='private-pilot-acs'), 'IV', 'Takeoffs, Landings, and Go-Arounds', 1)
INSERT INTO acs_tasks (area_id, code, title, order_index) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM acs_areas WHERE code='IV'), 'A', 'Normal Takeoff and Climb', 1)
INSERT INTO acs_tasks (area_id, code, title, order_index) VALUES ((SELECT id FROM acs_areas WHERE code='IV'), 'B', 'Soft-Field Landing', 2)

INSERT INTO scheduled_flights (asset_id, student_id, cfi_id, scheduled_date, scheduled_time, duration_hours, status) VALUES ({asset}, {student}, {cfi}, date('now','localtime'), strftime('%H:%M', 'now','localtime'), 1.0, 'scheduled')
